purpose: KSpaceJet CPU acceleration: Intel IPP, Intel oneMKL, and Intel OpenMP runtime

distribution.rule: Only reviewed redistributable binary files, their required headers, and required license/notices may be staged. Do not add an entire oneAPI SDK, installer, compiler executable, samples, or tools.

release_requirements: Every payload platform contains a text manifest-files.json with schema_version=1 and files=[{path,sha256}]; path is relative to payload/<platform>-x86_64 and every file below oneapi/ appears exactly once.
The payload uses shared libraries only: Linux *.a archives are forbidden; Windows *.lib files are allowed only as DLL import libraries.
The matching component licenses and all applicable third-party notices are copied into licenses/<platform>/ before release, retaining their component-relative paths.

licenses/linux/ and licenses/windows/ contain unmodified notice copies for the staged component versions. The Windows prebuilt payload does not carry them, so the corresponding same-version component notices are mirrored from the supplied Linux payload and require release/legal review.
A clean checkout followed by git lfs pull, conan export third_party/intel, and conan install succeeds without a system oneAPI installation.
